Storefront and customer routes of the categories module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/categories

Get category tree

Responses:

- `200`: Category tree retrieved.

## GET /v1/categories/{slug}

Get category by slug

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Category retrieved.
- `404`: Category not found.

## GET /v1/categories/{slug}/products

Get products in category

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).
- `page` in query (string, required).
- `pageSize` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Products retrieved.
- `404`: Category not found.
